root_idea.summary: The root centers on removing something from its skin, covering, or enclosing layer.
root_idea.development: The literal act of skinning extends to stripping clothing, shedding a slough, becoming detached, drawing daylight out of night, and metaphorically passing through or reaching the end of a period. Related nouns denote skins, sloughs, stripped objects, places of skinning, and things that shed or are shed.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation headword سَلَخَ rather than the imperfect QAC surface form نَسْلَخُ.
Displayed under the normalized Form VII citation headword اِنْسَلَخَ rather than the inflected QAC form ٱنسَلَخَ.

senses.definition: To draw something out or strip it away from what covers or surrounds it; in the Quran, to draw the daylight out of the night.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic occurrence describes the removal of النهار from الليل, with the image of one layer being stripped away from another.

senses.definition: To become detached or wholly separated from something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use at 7:175 describes detachment from a former state or attachment; the form is intransitive and presents the separation as occurring to the subject.

senses.definition: To pass away or come to the end of a period.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a defined period, especially a month or other span of time, as in the Quranic expression for the passing of the sacred months.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strip or skin the hide of a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The direct physical use is chiefly described with the hide of a sheep or goat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pull off or strip off a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with clothing as the object of removal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass through a month or reach its end.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative time expression, used of a month or its completion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause skin, hide, or feathers to peel or come off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested of heat, mange, or a disease affecting the covering of a person, animal, or bird.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a plant, to shed its foliage and become green again after drying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant-growth usage describing renewed greenness after the loss or drying of foliage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strip away the surface of a place by digging until water is reached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression comparing excavation to removing a hide.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be drawn out from the womb.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a child in a figurative passive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To replace the original words of a poem throughout with synonymous words.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage concerning extensive verbal substitution in poetry; a lesser degree is distinguished by another term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stripped of the skin or to become excoriated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of skin becoming removed or damaged, including through the action of heat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a serpent or other creeping thing, to cast off or withdraw from its slough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject is the creature that leaves its old outer covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become stripped or divested of one's clothes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive or reflexive clothing construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To emerge from or become wholly separate from something, especially of daylight emerging from night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction emphasizes complete separation or emergence from a surrounding state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lie upon one's side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal-noun usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The end of a month, especially its last day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal noun associated with the completion of a month.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The spun thread lying on a spindle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage for thread wound or placed upon the spindle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skinned sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One usage applies the term before any part has been eaten; another related usage can denote a fully prepared skinned animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Insipid or without taste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also occurs in the expression سَلِيخٌ مَلِيخٌ; the attribution is reported with lexical qualification.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man characterized by vigorous sexual intercourse without causing conception.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and rare description of a man and the stated sexual result.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Insipidity or tastelessness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression فِيهِ سَلَاخَةٌ for something or someone lacking taste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of skin or hide that has been stripped off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal result of the act of stripping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The urine of a mountain goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological or material term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A perfume or odoriferous substance resembling stripped bark and having forked projections.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized name for the described aromatic substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dry woody remainder of certain pasture plants after the useful foliage has been stripped away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of remth and ʿarfaj, including thick dried portions of the latter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The unseasoned oil of the fruit of the ban tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies before the oil is mixed with musk or other aromatics.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Offspring drawn out from the belly of its mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative usage based on removal from the womb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skinner or flayer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun for one who skins animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Skinning or flaying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting the act or practice of removing an animal's hide.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mange or scab that causes an animal to become excoriated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested especially of the condition affecting a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent that casts off its slough; specifically, a black serpent associated with this yearly shedding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The specialized serpent epithet is masculine in the cited expression, with distinct feminine and plural forms reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant that has shed its foliage and then become green again.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical usage describing renewed growth after shedding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very red, as though skinned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective applied to a man in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affected by mange or scab that excoriates the skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural form is applied to camels in the cited usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bald at the front of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A less common adjectival usage; another form is reported as more usual.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant's identification is uncertain and the form may be a dialectal variant or transcriptional variant of another plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where sheep or goats are skinned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun for the location of animal skinning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin or hide, especially the hide stripped from a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can also enter a figurative expression describing an outward human appearance concealing an incongruous character.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The slough of a serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal term for the outer covering cast off by a snake.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree whose unripe dates fall and become scattered while still green.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical usage.

cautions: Several rare or figurative branches are explicitly marked as assumed metaphorical in the lexical evidence; they are retained as Classical usages and are not presented as additional Quranic senses.
